info.title: Qaza Platform API
info.description: API documentation for Qaza Platform backend

bearerAuth.description: JWT access token supplied in the Authorization header as Bearer <token>.

cookieAuth.name: userRefreshToken
cookieAuth.description: HTTP-only user refresh token cookie used for user refresh/logout operations.

MinorAmountInteger.description: Monetary values are represented in minor units (for example, piasters/cents) as integers. Example: 2500 means 25.00 in the selected currency.

AdminRole.description: Administrative role assigned to an administrator account.

targetAmount.description: Project target amount in minor units.

collectedAmount.description: Funds collected so far in minor units.

beneficiariesCount.description: Number of targeted or served beneficiaries.

balance.description: Current wallet balance in minor units.

BadRequest.description: Bad Request — validation failed or malformed payload.

Unauthorized.description: Unauthorized — invalid, missing, expired, or unsigned request.

Conflict.description: Conflict — the requested resource already exists or is in a conflicting state.

post.summary: Deposit funds into the authenticated wallet

amount.description: Deposit amount in minor units (cents/piasters). Example 2500 = 25.00.

post.summary: Withdraw funds from the authenticated wallet

amount.description: Withdrawal amount in minor units (cents/piasters). Example 500 = 5.00.

401.description: Authentication failed or old password is incorrect

get.summary: Get donations belonging to the authenticated user

example.subject: Monthly Update
example.message: Thank you for supporting our projects.

400.description: Invalid settings data or empty update body

post.summary: Upload the site logo and persist it in platform settings
post.description: Uploads to Cloudinary and stores the resulting secure URL in the existing PlatformSettings record.

400.description: Logo image file is required or unsupported format

post.summary: Submit or update the authenticated user platform rating

400.description: Rating must be an integer from 1 to 5 or comment is too long

targetAmount.description: Project funding target in minor units (cents/piasters). Example 10000 = 100.00.

beneficiariesCount.description: Number of targeted or served beneficiaries.

targetAmount.description: Updated project funding target in minor units.

beneficiariesCount.description: Number of targeted or served beneficiaries.

amount.description: Amount to charge in minor units (cents/piasters). Example 2500 = 25.00.

204.description: Webhook processed successfully with no content.

get.summary: Get a live stream by ID

amount.description: Donation amount in minor units (cents/piasters). Example 1000 = 10.00.

404.description: Project or user was not found

post.summary: Process a donation payment webhook idempotently

200.description: Webhook processed successfully or idempotently acknowledged.

204.description: Webhook processed successfully with no content.

post.summary: Refresh the user access token using the userRefreshToken cookie
Log out the user and revoke the user refresh token

200.description: Logged out successfully. The user cookies are cleared.

post.summary: Verify a donor email address with a six-digit OTP

post.description: Returns a generic success response whether or not the email belongs to an unverified account to prevent email enumeration.

200.description: Generic OTP delivery response. The endpoint does not reveal whether the account exists or is already verified.

example.message: If the account exists and needs verification, a new OTP was sent

RateLimit-Limit.description: Maximum requests allowed in the current rate-limit window.

RateLimit-Remaining.description: Requests remaining in the current rate-limit window.

RateLimit-Reset.description: Unix timestamp when the current rate-limit window resets.

429.description: Too many OTP requests. The endpoint uses the authentication rate limiter, five requests per 15 minutes.

post.summary: Reset a donor password using an OTP
post.description: On successful reset, all active refresh-token sessions for the user are revoked.
